artworks.title: English Beggars (Les mendiants anglais)
artworks.description: The image shows four people seated on the ground in a row facing slightly to the right. The individuals include an elderly man with a bushy beard and long hair, a woman with a headscarf, another woman gesturing with her hands extended outward, and a young child. They are positioned against a backdrop of stone walls, wooden fence-like structures, and scaffolding or construction elements. The sky is depicted in a dynamic, linear style. A pathway on the right leads towards a gate or archway in the background.

artworks.title: Finding the Sheep (Le mouton retrouve)
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene where a seated figure is tending to a sheep. The point of view is slightly elevated, looking down at the figure. The horizon is low, with a row of trees in the background. Loose brushstrokes or pencil lines are used in the illustration, with detailed cross-hatching around the figure and trees for texture and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic, with soft shades of off-white and dark lines. Rustic elements like a tilted chair and a shepherd's crook on the ground complement the rural theme.

artworks.title: Fisherman with a Hoop-net (La peche a la truble)
artworks.description: The image shows a man outdoors, using a long tool to work in tall grasses and shrubs. Two trees stand in the middle, framing the scene. The background features rolling hills with vegetation. The artwork is created using detailed cross-hatched lines and stippling, with a sepia color palette.

artworks.title: Horse-driven Mill (Le manege)
artworks.description: The image shows a horse moving in a circular motion around a wooden post with a supporting structure. Three figures, who appear to be monks, are engaged in various tasks nearby. In the background, there is a slightly hilly landscape with a solitary shrub or small tree. The etching style features intricate crosshatch lines in shades of sepia and brown.

artworks.title: Vagabonds of Montrouge (Les vagabonds de Montrouge)
artworks.description: The image features an etching showing two figures near a rustic path. One figure leans on a walking stick while the other is cloaked. Nearby, a wheelbarrow is on its side with spilled contents. In the background, there are low buildings, fields, and trees leading to the horizon. The landscape is detailed with fine lines and crosshatching, creating a monochromatic appearance in shades of sepia. The color palette is neutral and subdued, typical of etchings, giving the scene an antique feel.

artworks.title: Plague Victims of Rome (Les pestiferes de Rome)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a religious procession comforting the afflicted. The image shows a group of people gathered on a street. Some are seated or kneeling, while others stand. The scene appears to involve a religious or charitable act, possibly providing aid to the poor or sick. On the left side of the image, there are individuals who appear distressed, with one person lying on the ground and another holding a child. Towards the right, a person in religious attire is offering what seems to be a chalice. The procession includes people holding tall candles and a crucifix. The background consists of stone buildings and a rural village setting, with a small animal present in the bottom right. The drawing features detailed linework, creating texture and depth in both the figures and background elements.

artworks.title: Choir in a Spanish Church (La choeur d'une eglise espagnole)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of musicians in an interior space. The scene shows a group of musicians playing and reading music. The central figure holds a larger stringed instrument, likely a bass, and sheet music is spread out before them. Other figures are focused on reading music from large books or participating in the music making, some possibly standing around an organ. The composition is rich with line work and crosshatching, creating a dark, atmospheric setting that reflects the intimate and concentrated nature of the musical gathering. Light and shadow emphasize depth and focus on the musicians and their expressions.

artworks.title: The Refectory (Le refectoire)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of monks seated around a dining table. The scene captures several monks engaged in a meal within a dimly-lit room. The table is covered with a simple cloth and has dishes laid out modestly. There is a sense of communal interaction as one monk appears to be serving another, and some of the other monks are partaking in the meal. In the background, an archway and a crucifix are visible. The drawing is rendered in a detailed cross-hatch style, emphasizing texture and shadow to convey a quiet, solemn atmosphere.

artworks.title: Procession in the Sepulchre of Saint Medard(Procession dans le caveaux de St.-Medard)
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people engaged in a processional activity. The figures are shown from the shoulders down, walking from left to right. They are dressed in heavy clothing with bonnets or headscarves covering their hair. Some are holding candles or objects. The background shows a gate on the left and a religious icon in the middle. The inscription at the bottom reads "CAVEAU ST MEDARD PROCESSION."

artworks.title: Breton Peasant (Paysan breton)
Head of a Model (Tete de modele)
Frederic Regamey
artworks.description: The image shows a head-and-shoulders portrait of a man with curly hair, pronounced eyebrows, a mustache, and a small beard. He is wearing a collared garment, possibly a coat or jacket, with a visible folded shirt collar. The background is plain with sketch-like shading, and the artist's signature is in the top left corner of the image.

artworks.title: Death of the Vagabond (La mort du vagabond)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated on the ground next to a tree. He is leaning against the tree with his legs stretched out and crossed at the ankles. His head is tilted back against the trunk of the tree, and his gaze is directed upwards. The man is wearing loose-fitting clothing, a hat is placed beside him on the ground, and his feet are bare. The surroundings include dense grass and shrubbery, and a barren tree leaning diagonally across the left side of the image. The sky in the background is textured and stark. No jewelry or additional objects are visible in the figure's possession.

artworks.title: Gust of Wind (Le coup de vent)
artworks.description: The image shows an outdoor scene with a winding path cutting through dense vegetation. The horizon is low in the composition, with a slope extending into the distance. Trees and shrubs can be seen on the horizon. The brushstroke technique is detailed, with fine etching lines capturing the texture of trees, bushes, and the pathway. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on shades of brown. The varying line densities add contrast and visual interest. Close-up details are rich, while distant elements are softer, suggesting a receding landscape.

artworks.title: Solitude (Solitude (Paysage))
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a landscape scene with an elevated point of view showing rolling hills with trees, detailed using an etching technique. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black, white, and grey. In the foreground, there are trees framing the left side and a figure with a hat sitting against a tree trunk. A winding path leads through hilly terrain with more trees in the background.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.artist: German 15th Century or Master with the Crossed Clubs
artworks.dimensions:
image: 17.9 x 11.7 cm (7 1/16 x 4 5/8 in.)
sheet: 18 x 11.9 cm (7 1/16 x 4 11/16 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 31.8 x 39.4 cm (12 1/2 x 15 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The image depicts three figures on crosses with a detailed background. The central figure is surrounded by a patterned backdrop consisting of intricate geometric designs. The two adjacent figures are also similarly posed. Below them are several other figures in flowing robes, engaged in expressions of emotion. The use of dark shading against the patterned background creates a contrast, highlighting the central narrative of the scene.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Lustful: Paolo and Francesca
artworks.description: This print features a swirling vortex of lines and circular shapes. People appear to be enveloped in the abstract, spiraling forms, which look similar to swirling waves. On the right, there are two people outside of these waves; one person is lying on their back with their arms by their sides, and another person is standing over them. They appear to be standing on a riverbank near the waves of people. Seeming to flow off of the person lying down is one of these flowing waves, within which a man and a woman float, seeming to reach for each other. Near the upper-right corner of the print is a circular, radiant shape containing a smaller depiction of two more people that appear to be facing each other and perhaps kissing.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Corrupt Officials; the Devils Tormenting Ciampolo
artworks.description: This drawing features several figures in a dramatic and dynamic interaction within a stylized landscape. The figures have muscular bodies and expressive postures, engaging with each other amidst swirling patterns in the background. The scene conveys a sense of tension and conflict.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Corrupt Officials; the Devils Tormenting Ciampolo
artworks.description: This is a black and white illustration of stylized figures in a dramatic scene. The figures are semi-nude with intense expressions. One figure appears reluctant or fearful, while others seem to be in motion, with one reaching out. The background features swirling lines, possibly representing a tumultuous environment. The figures are detailed, with focus on musculature and facial expressions, suggesting conflict or tension. Line work is used to depict movement and emotion among the figures.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Corrupt Officials; the Devils Mauling Each Other
artworks.description: This is a drawing of fantastical creatures engaged in a scene. The image depicts two winged figures, seemingly human-like, flying over swirling waters. They appear to be exerting effort or struggling. The background shows a curved pathway or horizon line, with two cloaked figures standing partially hidden. More figures are in the distance, some winged and others in various poses suggesting movement or interaction. The drawing features detailed line work and an imaginative subject matter in a style evocative of classical mythology or fantasy.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Thieves; Agnolo Brunelleschi Attacked by a Six-Footed Serpent
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with fantastical creatures and figures. Two clothed figures are on the left, observing a dragon-like creature in the center interacting with two nude figures on the right. Various serpent and reptilian forms are around the figures. The background shows a stylized landscape with abstract forms and mountain features. The artwork features detailed line work for depth and texture.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Thieves; Agnolo Brunelleschi Attacked by a Six-Footed Serpent
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with various figures in a rocky landscape. The image shows a creature with a distorted humanoid form, scaly texture, and a twisted body interacting with two other figures. Two robed figures are also present, observing the scene. The backdrop features abstract and jagged rock formations, and small serpentine creatures can be seen in the foreground.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Traitors; Dante's Foot Striking Bocca degli Abbate
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures standing amidst a surreal scene. The drawing portrays two cloaked figures standing in a landscape filled with partially submerged faces and bodies in what appears to be a body of water. The two figures are depicted with delicate features and long robes, and they seem to be observing the individuals trapped in the water below them. The surrounding water is drawn with lines to imply movement or the texture of the surface. Several figures are submerged, their faces showing expressions of distress or despair. A rocky formation with faces sculpted into it stands in the background, adding to the eerie and otherworldly atmosphere of the scene. The entire composition uses fine lines and detail to create a ghostly and ethereal mood.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Death: Proclamation (Le triomphe de la mort: La proclamation)
artworks.description: The image shows a crowd of people and a horse in a chaotic scene. The crowd includes figures holding a flag and various objects. The horse is in the center with its rider raising an arm. Various expressions and the dynamic composition create an atmosphere of unrest.
